name: Santa's Art Shop at the Springville Museum of Art
paras: The Springville Museum of Art hosts Santa's Art Shop on Thursday, December 10, 2026, from 5 to 7 PM at 126 E. 400 S. Admission is free and no registration is needed.
Kids meet Santa, enjoy cookies and milk, and make a variety of art projects. The museum plans activities for all ability levels, and Santa is on hand to oversee the work.
tip: Just walk in, since there is no sign-up to hold a spot.
